provenance.prompt:
Generate ONE isolated transparent-background pixel-art orthographic FRONT view of the exact Iron Stations platform-end ramp in the attached source/current/candidate contact. The contact's canonical source, source-faithful TOP candidate, and approved RIGHT/LEFT wedge profiles are authoritative. This is the low LEADING END of the grounded ramp, opposite the higher solid REAR end. Do not duplicate the high rear profile.

The ramp lies flat on a square XY tile. Camera is horizontal from the front/south edge, looking inward toward the raised concrete platform. Show only a thin, low edge-on elevation across the full 220px tile width, with total height about 25–35px on a 256px canvas, bottom aligned at y=248. It should read as the low front lip / shallow slab edge of the ramp. The tactile yellow strip and diagonal black-yellow hazard marks are top-surface features and must appear only as tiny edge slivers, never as a broad topdown face. No tall posts, no square tile face, no platform-wall facade, no ramp wedge from the side. Preserve gray concrete and dark steel edge materials with source palette; no perspective, grid, text, shadow, detached guide marks or clipping. Crisp pixel-art clusters.
